motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of KJ Call as Youth City Council Mayor until the next Youth Council ele…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve the appointment of KJ Call as Youth City Council Mayor until the next Youth Council election . Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: KJ Call named youth council mayor
motions.summary: KJ Call will lead the Youth City Council as its mayor until the next Youth Council election, under an appointment the council approved.
motions.impact: A title for one student, and a line for the city's youth program. Nothing in how the city runs shifts.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Youth City Council Members until the next Youth Council election
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to approve the appointment of Youth City Council Members until the next Youth Council election . Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Youth council members appointed
motions.summary: The city seated new Youth City Council members, who serve until the next Youth Council election.
motions.impact: This one matters to the teenagers who applied and their families. City services and your wallet are untouched.

motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council cleared its consent agenda, the batch of routine items handled in one vote; the record does not list what was in it.
motions.impact: Consent items are the ones nobody flagged for discussion. Nothing here lands on your street or your bill.

motions.item_title: A pprove Agenda Item 16.A. according to the chart of effected properties
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to a pprove Agenda Item 16.A. according to the chart of effected properties. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Vote on item 16.A property chart
motions.summary: Item 16.A came to a vote on the terms of a chart of affected properties; the record does not show what the item covers or how it ended.
motions.impact: Without a description or a result in the record, there is nothing here we can tell you about your own property. The chart in the meeting packet is the place to check.

motions.item_title: Amend the motion to approve the General Plan Amendment according to the chart of affected prope…
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to amend the motion to approve the General Plan Amendment according to the chart of affected properties for this item and to approve the zoning in accordance with the proposed rezoning map for each of the properties. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Zoning changed on a list of properties
motions.summary: The council approved general plan and zoning changes for the properties listed on a chart, with each parcel rezoned according to the proposed rezoning map.
motions.impact: Owners of the listed parcels, and their neighbors, are the people this reaches: what can be built there changes. The record names a chart rather than addresses, so check the meeting packet for your parcel.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, amending the Master Plan Known as the Transportation Master Plan (TMP) and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP) , with the staff recommendations presented, with the addition of E 1000 N as Minor Collector from Pony Express Pkwy to East Expressway and the removal of the connection at Canyon Wash
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, amending the Master Plan Known as the Transportation Master Plan (TMP) and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP) , with the staff recommendations presented, with the addition of E 1000 N as Minor Collector from Pony Express Pkwy to East Expressway and the removal of the connection at Canyon Wash . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Road plan adds E 1000 N, drops Canyon Wash link
motions.summary: The council updated the city road plan, adding E 1000 N as a minor collector from Pony Express Parkway to the East Expressway and dropping a Canyon Wash connection.
motions.impact: If you live near E 1000 N, that stretch is now mapped as a through road between Pony Express Parkway and the East Expressway, and the Canyon Wash connection is off the map. Nothing is built yet; the plan also steers impact fees.
